geometry: Eight colored 45-degree circular arcs with a radial transparency fade at the inner and outer edges.
limitations: Smooth reconstructed contours and antialiasing approximate the source; native and 8x renders were inspected.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
